source_uncertainties: Uploader subtitle track production method unknown; publisher label does not establish human generation.
Canonical duration is retained-media ffprobe, distinct from caption metadata whole-second playlist declaration.
Spoken standard-deviation halving corrected to variance halving and SD divided by square root of two under independent averaging.
Mean change is not a complete definition of evolution; distribution and genetic composition can change without a mean shift.
Perfect phenotype copying, certain finite-time fixation and universal loss of diversity are schematic assumptions rather than general inheritance/selection laws.
Moth disappearance is partly directly observed bird predation and partly inferred under behavior assumptions; survival stage is not lifetime reproductive contribution.
Nachman primary text inspected in author-uploaded web full text; initial local PDF/PMC routes failed and are not represented as successful evidence.
